name: wrk
description: Modern HTTP benchmarking tool written in Go with concurrent connections, customizable headers, and performance analytics

wrk.description: High-performance HTTP load testing tool with goroutine-based concurrency and SSL/TLS support for web application benchmarking
wrk.usage:
wrk -c 100 -d 30 http://example.com
wrk -c 50 -d 10 -M POST -body @data.json http://api.example.com
wrk -c 200 -d 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer token" https://secure.example.com
wrk -c 10 -d 5 -no-ka http://example.com
wrk -f playbook.txt -c 50 -d 30
